description: List the wrapped coding-agent CLIs and whether each can actually run (edits nothing). Each entry reports `installed` (binary resolves on PATH with the exec bit) and `usable` (a probe succeeded), plus a `reason` when it cannot run; `available` mirrors `usable`. A CLI can be installed but unusable — codex exits 0 from `--version` even when its home is unwritable and no real run can succeed — so prefer `usable`. Read-only; call this first to choose an agent before delegating.
name: list_agents
